summary: Frontend-only verification of the duplicate Cancel button bug fix on Contracts feed. Confirmed via UI + API setup that exactly ONE Cancel button renders per poster-owned contract card across all tested scenarios (single-role open, multi-role open with 1 accepted participant — the previously failing case). Non-posters see 0 Cancel buttons. Cancel action still works end-to-end: confirm() dialog fires, POST /api/contracts/{id}/cancel is invoked, status transitions to 'cancelled' both server-side and in UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in Contracts.jsx lines 1849-1891 is correct: the inner Cancel button inside the 'In Progress' actions block was removed, and the standalone Cancel block's status whitelist was broadened to ['open','mustering','in_progress','pending_completion','active']. The duplicate render for poster + multi/is_multi_crew + status='open' + accepted_participants>0 is no longer possible because there is now exactly one location that renders the Cancel button, gated only by (poster_id === user.id && status in whitelist).
data-testid `cancel-btn-{contract.id}` is properly attached to the single Cancel button — good for automation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Test evidence: (a) DOM scan on multi-role poster card with 1 accepted participant found exactly 1 button matching 'CANCEL' text and 1 element with selector cancel-btn-{id}; (b) same for single-role open contract; (c) admin viewing demo's cards showed 0 cancel buttons; (d) clicking Cancel triggered window.confirm() which was accepted, and GET /api/contracts/{id} returned status='cancelled'. Note: onboarding/tutorial modal auto-opens on /contracts for fresh demo sessions — must be dismissed via the SVG X close button before button clicks work (force=True on button under modal still fires the DOM click but React confirm doesn't fire until the modal overlay is closed).
rca of the issue: Original RCA (per E1): for poster on multi-role 'open' contract with at least one accepted participant, the 'In Progress' actions block's 4th OR clause matched and rendered its inner Cancel button, while the standalone OPEN/MUSTERING Cancel block also rendered — producing two side-by-side CANCEL buttons. Fix removed the inner Cancel and consolidated to a single standalone Cancel gated by a broader status whitelist. Verified fix is effective in production preview build.
